cohort: A pooled total of 5896 live births recorded across selected years (1993, 1998, 2003, 2008, 2013) in Chieti, Italy.
finding: While the number of SGA and LGA births increased over two decades, their overall incidence remained stable, with hypertension, smoking, and previous miscarriage associated with SGA, and greater pre-pregnancy BMI and gestational diabetes with LGA.
cross-section timing: Data were collected for the years 1993, 1998, 2003, 2008, and 2013.
birth_weight: <10th percentile for SGA, >90th percentile for LGA
gest_age: Used to define SGA (<10th percentile for gestational age) and LGA (>90th percentile for gestational age).
